as_told.title: RS 33, a secret Italian cabinet to study extraterrestrials led by Marconi

plain: In 1933, the story goes, the Italian government under the dictator Benito Mussolini set up a secret research group called Gabinetto RS33, or Cabinet RS33. The radio pioneer Guglielmo Marconi chaired it and the physicist Enrico Fermi was its vice president, and it studied what they call the extraterrestrial issue. Michels tells it himself, saying the group reportedly drew up a nine-step protocol for the Magenta crash, a reported 1933 crash of an unknown craft in northern Italy, and for any like it, and he calls it Italy's version of Majestic 12, a supposed secret US panel on UFOs. His main source is a prince who says he is Marconi's grandson. The grandson tells the show he knew it through the family, not from documents. In his account the dates differ: once 1933, once 1953, when he says the committee studied UFO sightings near Varese in northern Italy. If true, a European government was handling crashed craft more than a decade before the US.
